name: Oracle and Input Corruption
definition: The mechanism executes correctly on an input that is wrong, stale, manipulated, or injected.
trigger_conditions: Any input crosses a trust boundary without attestation
A single source can determine an input value
No staleness bound or sanity range is enforced
citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F025 Oracle and Input Corruption. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F025
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
